meta.strategy: frozen V4 signal path plus theory-first exposure budgeting
meta.phase2_reason: phase 1 CPPI met drawdown control but lost return through persistent cash lock; phase 2 resets its loss budget only on a V4 holding change
meta.phase3_reason: the maximum drawdown crossed many V4 holdings, so phase 3 preserves one accident state across rotations and retains minimum participation
meta.phase4_reason: without a validated timing predictor, first-order risk and drawdown are approximately homogeneous in exposure; 80% is derived from the 20% MDD-reduction objective rather than selected from a return scan
meta.phase5_reason: volatility control reduced historical MDD while shock control addressed the documented clustered-loss path; their minimum adds no parameter
meta.controller_cost_model: two ETF legs per exposure change, in addition to scaled V4 sleeve costs
meta.no_lookahead: exposure used on day T was fixed at T-1; T observations only set the next period exposure
meta.execution_warning: official close is a same-price 14:50 proxy; gap losses before the observation cannot be prevented
meta.frozen_path_approximation_warning: the exposure controller scales the archived V4 sleeve return and does not feed its lower equity path back into risk_overrides; an integrated engine replay is required before any implementation review

theory.objective: retain at least 80% of V4 CAGR while reducing MDD magnitude at least 20%, without adding negative years or failing 2x costs
theory.shock_rule: next-period x<=50% after held asset 1d<=-5%; x=0 after 3d<=-10%
theory.position_budget_rule: full exposure through 5% position drawdown, linear to zero at 10%, then reset only after frozen V4 changes the holding
theory.episode_budget_rule: at 10% portfolio drawdown use 50% exposure until recovery to 5%; at 20% use 25%; combine with the stricter asset-shock cap
theory.constant_budget_rule: 80% frozen V4 sleeve plus 20% defense, daily rebalanced; the shock variant applies the pre-registered 50%/0% next-period caps
theory.guarantee_limit: daily discrete execution creates gap risk; the 80% floor is soft, not a guaranteed payoff

documented_shock_scenario.execution_rule: T-day 14:50 signal controls only the exposure after that observation

5.scope_warning: resamples realized fixed-policy returns; it does not reselect parameters

parameter_robustness.definition: one-axis center plus +/-20% risk and shock perturbations

assessment.interpretation: A historical pass can nominate a frozen shadow path, but zero untouched post-design observations cannot validate the controller.
